title: Online Learning with Ordered Experts (via Two-point Feedback)
abstract: arXiv:2611.07629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study adversarial online learning with expert recommendations in a totally ordered action space, where the experts' recommendations may change and be reordered arbitrarily. Our focus is two-point feedback: on each round the learner plays two current recommendations, observes both, and pays their average. We study two problems. In the separated monotone problem, the loss is the sum of a hidden nondecreasing component and a hidden nonincreasing component, and a query reveals the two components separately. In the BV problem, the losses are bounded and have bounded variation (BV) along the order, and a query reveals only the loss.   In the separated monotone problem, two paid observations achieve \[ O\bigl(\log(|\cF|T)\sqrt{T\log|\cF|}\bigr) \] regret against the best of $|\cF|$ experts, within a logarithmic factor of the classical full-information bound. translated_title: 基于有序专家的在线学习（通过两点反馈）
translated_abstract: 我们研究了完全有序动作空间中带有专家推荐的对抗性在线学习问题，其中专家的推荐可能发生变化并被任意重新排序。我们的重点是两点反馈：在每一轮中，学习者选择两个当前推荐进行操作，同时观察两者，并支付它们的平均损失。我们研究了两个问题。在分离单调问题中，损失是一个隐藏的非递减分量与一个隐藏的非递增分量之和，查询会分别揭示这两个分量。在有界变差（BV）问题中，损失是有界的，且沿该顺序具有有界变差，查询仅揭示损失值。在分离单调问题中，两次付费观测相对于|F|个专家中的最优者实现了 O(log(|F|T)√(T log|F|)) 的遗憾，与经典的全信息界仅相差一个对数因子。对于BV问题，我们获得了 Õ(√T + |F|) 的遗憾。我们给出了一个应用……
tldr: 该论文研究了完全有序动作空间中基于两点反馈的在线学习问题，在分离单调损失下实现了仅比全信息界差一个对数因子的 O(log(|F|T)√(T log|F|)) 遗憾，在有界变差损失下实现了 Õ(√T+|F|) 的遗憾。
en_tdlr: This paper studies adversarial online learning with ordered experts under two-point feedback, achieving O(log(|F|T)√(T log|F|)) regret for the separated monotone problem (within a logarithmic factor of the full-information bound) and Õ(√T+|F|) regret for the bounded variation problem.
